a.lede: OpenAI has introduced a new "locked chats" feature to protect users' more sensitive conversations with ChatGPT.
a.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock sensitive chats behind a PIN

b.lede: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.
b.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
